observations: Free-standing cooker range, stainless/silver body, with glass splashback lid raised in photos 0 and 1.
Cooktop shows 4 round gas-burner grates and 2 flat black solid-plate (electric) hotplates, matching the seller's '4 gas + 2 burner = 6 burner' description.
Photo 1 shows two of the four gas burners lit with visible blue flame, the other two gas burners and both electric plates are not shown lit or glowing.
Front control panel (photo 0 and photo 2) shows only two physical knobs attached; several round knob-holes are empty, suggesting missing or lost control knobs for other burners/oven.
Photo 2 shows the unit from an angle with a wooden stick wedged under the oven door/handle area, possibly propping something open or supporting a loose part.
Oven cavity glass (photo 2) looks dusty/stained inside, no light, flame, or heat demonstrated.
No brand name, model number, or rating plate is legible in any photo; only the 'PEEJAY' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' watermarks are visible, which are marketplace watermarks, not product branding.

Close-up of the full control panel confirming all knobs are present and functional

response.reason: The item is clearly a 6-burner gas-and-electric cooker range matching the seller's description in count, but only 2 of the 6 cooking zones are shown working, several control knobs are missing, and the oven and structural integrity are unproven, so it must be priced at this worst-case condition pending further proof.
